breakdown.description: ΔL/L_0 is engineering strain; true strain is ln(L/L_0).
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to correct the definition of true strain. The incomplete prompt incorrectly stated the formula was ε_t = ΔL/L_0, which is for engineering strain. The ground truth provides the correct formula: ε_t = ln(L/L_0). The generated specification repeated the incorrect formula from the original prompt and used it to perform the calculation, thereby failing to resolve the inconsistency.
